extraction_limitations: Atoms capture independently reviewable, load-bearing methods, benchmark results, ablations, resource costs, limitations, and representative success/failure cases; references were not atomized.

The current LiteratureAtom schema is generic and clinical-literature-oriented; AI/ML benchmark populations, system variants, latency, memory, and cost are represented using the closest available population/exposure/outcome/quantitative-result fields and descriptive tags.
All atoms are marked needs_review because no independent human verification pass was performed.
No external sources were used; extraction is grounded in the uploaded preprint only.
